title: Confirmed: Barcelona star wins La Liga Goal of the Month for September
tweet:
Joao Cancelo has won La Liga Goal of the Month for September with a 7‑2 opener strike against Racing Santander.  
The 32‑year‑old’s left‑back debut included a solo screamer from the outside, proving his continued threat on the flank.  
As things stand, his goal underlines a pattern of late‑season quality that may boost confidence heading into the final stretch.

title: Official: Barcelona deny UEFA opening new investigation in Negreira case after Real Madrid complaint
tweet: UEFA confirms it has simply received Real Madrid’s dossier on Negreira, not opened a new disciplinary file. Barça insists the existing investigation remains unchanged and that no new requests have been issued. The case stays under review, but what actions investigators will take remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona superstar duo top shirt sales so far in 2026-27
tweet: Lamine Yamal's number 10 tops Barça shirt sales this season, selling at nearly three times the rate of the runner‑up, a rise that echoes Messi's historic impact.

title: Barcelona calm after UEFA statement on Negreira case following Real Madrid complain: ‘All smoke and mirrors’
tweet: UEFA has received documents from Real Madrid and will reopen the Negreira case. As things stand, Barça remains clear of any new charges; the move appears more a media distraction than evidence of wrongdoing.

title: Barcelona midfielder making progress in his recovery, will rejoin group training next week
tweet: De Jong will resume group training next week, signalling steady knee recovery, but with no fixed return date the staff will still gauge pain levels before deciding a competitive comeback.

title: Raphinha injury update: Barcelona investigating worrying pattern after latest Brazil setback
tweet: Raphinha’s latest thigh problem is the third in a row during Brazil camps, all on the right side. As things stand, Barça’s medical team will probe his pre‑match routines for a common trigger, hoping to prevent another recurrence.
